source.citation: Institute for Safe Medication Practices (ISMP) & U.S. FDA CDER Name Differentiation Project.

levels.title: Level 1: Core Look-Alike Stems & Generic Confusions
levels.description: Foundational generic medication pairs with look-alike prefixes and orthographic stems.

levels.title: Level 2: Oncology & High-Alert Dosing Distinctions
levels.description: High-alert and antineoplastic medication pairs with critical therapeutic and dosing differences.

levels.title: Level 3: Cardiovascular, Antimicrobial & Suffix Variations
levels.description: Antimicrobials, calcium channel blockers, and psychotropics with subtle suffix differences.

levels.title: Level 4: Critical Care & Opioid Analogues
levels.description: Potent opioids, sedatives, and critical care agents requiring meticulous Tall Man verification.

levels.title: Level 5: Brand-Name & Sound-Alike Formulations
levels.description: Confusable brand names and specialized formulations documented in ISMP MERP reports.

entries.riskSummary: Confusion between an antidepressant/smoking cessation aid and an anxiolytic; risk of seizure (bupropion overdose) or untreated anxiety/depression.
entries.source: FDA Name Differentiation Project & ISMP Tall Man List
entries.sourceCitation: FDA Table 1 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Severe hypotension from accidental hydralazine, or unintended central nervous system sedation from hydroxyzine.
entries.source: FDA Name Differentiation Project & ISMP Tall Man List
entries.sourceCitation: FDA Table 1 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Dosing errors in pediatric/hepatic failure populations where conversion from prednisone to active prednisolone is impaired.
entries.source: FDA Name Differentiation Project & ISMP Tall Man List
entries.sourceCitation: FDA Table 1 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Excessive sedation, hypotension, unmanaged acute pain, or increased risk of serotonin syndrome.

entries.sourceCitation: ISMP Table 2 Recommended Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Severe bradycardia and hypotension from clonidine, or central nervous system depression and dependence issues from clonazepam.
entries.source: FDA Name Differentiation Project & ISMP Tall Man List
entries.sourceCitation: FDA Table 1 Generic Tall Man List (cloNIDine confused with clonazePAM); ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Potency and duration differences leading to oversedation, respiratory depression, or altered seizure threshold.

entries.sourceCitation: FDA Table 1 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Agranulocytosis, severe orthostatic hypotension, seizures, and metabolic side effects from accidental clozapine administration.

entries.sourceCitation: FDA Table 1 Generic Tall Man List (cloZAPine confused with clonazePAM); ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Uncontrolled pain or inflammation vs. psychiatric destabilization, QT prolongation, or serotonin toxicity.

entries.sourceCitation: FDA Table 1 Brand Name Tall Man List (CeleBREX / CeleXA); ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Hydromorphone is 4 to 7 times more potent than morphine; administering hydromorphone at morphine doses frequently results in fatal respiratory arrest.
entries.source: ISMP List of Confused Drug Names & High-Alert Medications
entries.sourceCitation: ISMP List of Confused Drug Names; FDA Table 1 (Tall Man designation for HYDROmorphone)

entries.riskSummary: Hemodynamic instability, dangerous tachycardia, or inappropriate peripheral vasoconstriction/vasodilation in critical care.
entries.source: FDA Name Differentiation Project & ISMP Tall Man List
entries.sourceCitation: FDA Table 1 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Potency mismatch leading to either inadequate analgesia or opioid overdose and hypoventilation.

entries.sourceCitation: ISMP Table 2 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Prolonged, severe hypoglycemia, especially in elderly patients or those with renal impairment given glyburide.
entries.source: FDA Name Differentiation Project & ISMP Tall Man List
entries.sourceCitation: FDA Table 1 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Lactic acidosis and GI distress vs. untreated anaerobic infection or disulfiram-like ethanol reaction.

entries.sourceCitation: ISMP Table 2 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Severe hypoglycemia in non-diabetic patients or uncontrolled intraocular pressure/acid-base imbalance.

entries.sourceCitation: FDA Table 1 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Dramatically different dosing schedules; cisplatin dosed at carboplatin levels causes fatal nephrotoxicity, neurotoxicity, and ototoxicity.
entries.source: FDA Name Differentiation Project & ISMP Tall Man List
entries.sourceCitation: FDA Table 1 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Severe toxicity, fluid retention, neuropathy, and neutropenia due to differing dosing frequencies and premedication protocols.
entries.source: ISMP List of Look-Alike Drug Names with Recommended Tall Man Letters
entries.sourceCitation: ISMP Table 2 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP Targeted Medication Safety Best Practices

entries.riskSummary: Dosing regimen errors leading to irreversible, cumulative cardiotoxicity and severe myelosuppression.
entries.source: FDA Name Differentiation Project & ISMP Tall Man List
entries.sourceCitation: FDA Table 1 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Vincristine is dosed in fractions of the dose of vinblastine; administering vinblastine doses using vincristine causes fatal neurotoxicity.

entries.sourceCitation: FDA Table 1 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Subtherapeutic resuscitation in anaphylaxis/cardiac arrest, or extreme hypertension and tachyarrhythmia from incorrect potency delivery.

entries.sourceCitation: FDA Table 1 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Hyperkalemia and dehydration vs. unmanaged hypertension or peripheral edema.
entries.source: FDA Name Differentiation Project & ISMP Tall Man List
entries.sourceCitation: FDA Table 1 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Unmanaged neuropathic pain, differences in discontinuation syndrome, or heightened risk of serotonergic excess.
entries.source: ISMP List of Look-Alike Drug Names with Recommended Tall Man Letters
entries.sourceCitation: ISMP Table 2 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Severe anticholinergic side effects, abrupt discontinuation syndrome with missed paroxetine, and drug-drug metabolic interactions.

entries.sourceCitation: ISMP Table 2 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Extrapyramidal symptoms, severe sedation, or metabolic syndrome in a patient merely requiring acid suppression.

entries.sourceCitation: FDA Table 1 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Severe bone marrow ablation/failure vs. acute transplant rejection or uncontrolled autoimmune flare.
entries.source: FDA Name Differentiation Project & ISMP Tall Man List

entries.riskSummary: Spectrum-of-activity mismatch leading to therapeutic failure in serious CNS or multi-drug resistant bacterial infections.

entries.sourceCitation: FDA Table 1 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Dosing interval mismatches, potential bleeding risk/coagulopathy associated with the N-methylthiotetrazole (NMTT) chain in cefotetan.
entries.source: FDA Name Differentiation Project & ISMP Tall Man List
entries.sourceCitation: FDA Table 1 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Inadequate coverage for Pseudomonas aeruginosa infections, leading to sepsis and therapeutic failure.
entries.source: FDA Name Differentiation Project & ISMP Tall Man List
entries.sourceCitation: FDA Table 1 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Profound, protracted hypoglycemia in non-diabetic patients vs. extreme sedation, dystonia, and neuroleptic side effects.
entries.source: FDA Name Differentiation Project & ISMP Tall Man List
entries.sourceCitation: FDA Table 1 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Unintended ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome (OHSS) vs. cardiotoxicity, anticholinergic toxicity, and seizure risk.

entries.sourceCitation: FDA Table 1 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Acute organ transplant rejection / nephrotoxicity from cyclosporine errors, or neurotoxicity and failed TB management from cycloserine errors.
entries.source: FDA Name Differentiation Project & ISMP Tall Man List
entries.sourceCitation: FDA Table 1 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Extreme bone marrow suppression, tissue necrosis, and severe toxicity from accidentally administering chemotherapy for an infection.
entries.source: FDA Name Differentiation Project & ISMP Tall Man List
entries.sourceCitation: FDA Table 1 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Dosing discrepancy (dimenhydrinate contains roughly half the milligram potency of diphenhydramine), leading to under- or over-sedation.
entries.source: FDA Name Differentiation Project & ISMP Tall Man List
entries.sourceCitation: FDA Table 1 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Depo-Medrol injected intravenously can cause fatal microembolism, respiratory arrest, and cardiac arrest; it is strictly contraindicated for IV use.
entries.source: FDA Name Differentiation Project & ISMP Tall Man List
entries.sourceCitation: FDA Table 1 Brand Name Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Sufentanil is roughly 5 to 10 times more potent than fentanyl; confusing doses causes immediate, lethal respiratory depression.
entries.source: ISMP List of Look-Alike Drug Names with Recommended Tall Man Letters
entries.sourceCitation: ISMP Table 2 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Pharmacologically opposing mechanisms: risperidone blocks dopamine (worsening Parkinson's), while ropinirole can trigger psychosis.
entries.source: FDA Name Differentiation Project & ISMP Tall Man List
entries.sourceCitation: FDA Table 1 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Crystalluria, acute renal injury, allergic hypersensitivity reactions, or untreated parasitic infections.
entries.source: FDA Name Differentiation Project & ISMP Tall Man List
entries.sourceCitation: FDA Table 1 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Different milligram potencies and pharmacokinetics triggering severe, unpredictable hypoglycemia.
entries.source: FDA Name Differentiation Project & ISMP Tall Man List
entries.sourceCitation: FDA Table 1 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Timing/onset mismatch leading to acute postprandial hyperglycemia followed by severe, delayed hypoglycemia.
entries.source: ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Mismatch in onset and peak activity causing unpredictable blood glucose fluctuations and severe hypoglycemia.
entries.source: ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.source: ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Loss of seizure control or mood instability vs. untreated fungal infection and hepatotoxicity risks; lamotrigine carries black-box risks of Stevens-Johnson syndrome.

entries.sourceCitation: ISMP Table 3 Brand Name Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Severe central nervous system sedation, orthostatic hypotension, falls, and metabolic disturbances in patients needing a simple allergy tablet.
entries.source: ISMP List of Confused Drug Names & Tall Man List
entries.sourceCitation: ISMP Table 3 Brand Name Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Severe bradycardia, heart block, or rebound hypertension vs. cognitive slowing, metabolic acidosis, and breakthrough seizures.
entries.source: ISMP List of Confused Drug Names
entries.sourceCitation: ISMP List of Confused Drug Names; ISMP MERP Reporting Bulletin

entries.riskSummary: Tricyclic overdose symptoms (cardiac arrhythmias, QRS widening, anticholinergic toxidrome) or extrapyramidal and metabolic symptoms.
entries.source: ISMP List of Confused Drug Names
entries.sourceCitation: ISMP List of Confused Drug Names; FDA Public Health Advisory

entries.riskSummary: Neuropsychiatric disruption, drug-induced tremor/insomnia, or failed suppression of severe peptic ulcer bleeding.
entries.source: FDA Safety Alerts & ISMP List of Confused Drug Names
entries.sourceCitation: FDA MedWatch Safety Alert (Prilosec/Prozac name confusion); ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Dosing difference (tenecteplase is a single weight-based bolus, alteplase is a bolus plus infusion); errors cause massive intracranial hemorrhage or subtherapeutic thrombolysis in stroke/MI.
entries.source: ISMP List of Look-Alike Drug Names with Recommended Tall Man Letters
entries.sourceCitation: ISMP Table 2 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP Acute Care Safety Guidelines

entries.riskSummary: Profound myelosuppression, leukopenia, and thrombocytopenia from unintended cytotoxic hydroxyurea administration.
entries.source: ISMP List of Look-Alike Drug Names with Recommended Tall Man Letters
entries.sourceCitation: ISMP Table 2 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP List of Confused Drug Names

entries.riskSummary: Severe embryofetal toxicity, deep vein thrombosis/pulmonary embolism, and intense cytopenias from lenalidomide.
entries.source: ISMP List of Look-Alike Drug Names with Recommended Tall Man Letters
entries.sourceCitation: ISMP Table 2 Generic Tall Man List; ISMP Medication Safety Alert!

entries.riskSummary: Profound sedation, severe bradycardia, and hypotension from dexmedetomidine, or acute glycemic decompensation and immune suppression from dexamethasone.
